Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
car...@airmail.com wrote:
>
> just something I've been fooling around with.
> The picture is from the cover of a Paranoia novel
> "Title deleted for security reasons"

A suggestion for the card text:
It should not be self-stackable (i.e., you can't play
20 good aims to get +20R damage on a gun strike).

The easiest way to do this would be to mimic the
Lucky Blow template:

Good Aim - combat:
Strike: Use your Gun at +1R damage.

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@regency.wizards.com)
Official VtES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
(*) - Subject to review by Rules Team
